text:
Kevin: Hey team — I pushed a follow-up to the PR that addresses the requested changes. Split the large refactor into two commits, removed the artificial `sleep` in kv-allocator, and added a tiny integration test for the batching path. Rebased on main and resolved the conflict in `runtime/batcher.go`. Please take a quick sweep when you have a minute: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/482

Rachel: glanced through — overall looks good. one small nit in `runtime/batcher.go`: prefer an early return to avoid the nested if on L213. also saw one flaky case in the windows runner for `batcher_integration_test` — can you add a slightly higher timeout there or make the clock deterministic?

Kevin: thanks — switched to early return, added a test harness toggle (env var) to force deterministic timing for CI, and bumped the timeout for the windows job. squashed the refactor commits into one and force-pushed:```
git checkout feature/batching-refactor
git rebase origin/main
# fixed conflict in runtime/batcher.go
git commit --amend -m "runtime: simplify batcher control flow; add deterministic test harness"
git push -f origin feature/batching-refactor
```

ci-bot: build/test: ✅ linux / macos unit tests passed; macos/flaky rerun queued. windows job rerun started. :robot_face:

Tiago: LGTM from infra side — the kernel selection change looks fine. one operational ask: can we include a short release-note entry so ops knows the behavior change for batching under low-latency mode? planning to merge during tomorrow's morning canary window unless rachel requests otherwise. :calendar:

Rachel: approving this once the windows job is green. please add the one-line changelog and I'll merge in the morning. :white_check_mark:

Kevin: added changelog line at `docs/CHANGELOG.md` and pushed. thanks — will watch CI and ping again if anything breaks.

Marco: I'll monitor the canary rollout tomorrow 09:00 PT and keep an eye on latency dashboards. ping me if you need a rollback. :eyes:

Tiago: noted — if CI is green by 08:45 PT I'll go ahead with the merge and start the canary. Kevin, thanks for the quick follow-ups. :thumbsup:

Rachel: CI green now on all platforms — approving.

Kevin: thanks everyone — scheduling merge for 09:00 PT canary. cc @Marco for monitoring. :shipit:
__note: This thread is a short review follow-up: addressed comments, rebased and squashed, added changelog, waited for CI, scheduled canary merge. Messages are chronological.
